summaries.name: Holiday Market
summaries.summary: The Holiday Market is an annual event at the local mall, held a week before Black Friday, featuring unique handmade jewelry vendors. The user attended it and plans to return to look more closely at jewelry to pair with a birthday gift for their sister.

summaries.name: Zazzle
summaries.summary: Zazzle is a platform for designing custom phone cases and other products like mugs, t-shirts, and invitations, with a vast library of templates, fonts, and images.

summaries.name: CaseApp
summaries.summary: CaseApp is a user-friendly website offering a wide range of phone case designs, including custom options with the ability to upload images or use templates and editing tools.

summaries.name: Society6
summaries.summary: Society6 is a platform for designing custom phone cases and other products like laptop skins, tote bags, and wall art.

summaries.name: Shutterfly
summaries.summary: Shutterfly is an online retailer offering customizable products, including journals, with various templates, fonts, and images.

summaries.name: Blurb
summaries.summary: Blurb is a self-publishing platform offering customizable journal templates, allowing users to upload their own content, images, and text.

summaries.name: Mixbook
summaries.summary: Mixbook is a digital publishing platform for creating custom journals, as well as other products like photo books and cards.

summaries.name: Canva
summaries.summary: Canva is a graphic design tool offering templates and design elements for products including phone cases and journals. The user decided to try Canva to design a custom phone case for their sister's birthday, planning a simple design with her name in an elegant font plus a small personal message like "Sis" or "Birthday Girl."

summaries.name: Adobe Spark
summaries.summary: Adobe Spark is a free design tool for creating custom designs for social media, web, and print, including phone cases and journals. The user considered using it to design a custom phone case for their sister's birthday.
